recognize_zh: 上方兩個巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），直徑遠大於周圍細胞（對照 10 µm 比例尺），細胞質極深藍並有扇貝狀邊緣，核內染色質被擠向核膜、中央呈淡紫色毛玻璃樣包涵體，形成「燈籠細胞（lantern cell）」外觀，是 Parvovirus B19 感染的典型表現。
features: Giant pronormoblasts (roughly 30-40 µm by scale bar) with intensely basophilic, deep blue cytoplasm and scalloped borders
Large round nucleus with a pale, glassy lilac intranuclear inclusion and chromatin marginated to the nuclear rim (lantern-like appearance)
Perinuclear zone slightly paler than peripheral cytoplasm
Adjacent large macrophage with vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and a big nucleus (lower field)
Scattered smaller erythroid/myeloid precursors and erythrocytes; mature normoblasts appear scarce
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two giant pronormoblasts with very large round nuclei containing pale, glassy intranuclear inclusions with peripherally condensed chromatin, surrounded by deeply basophilic cytoplasm with scalloped margins. A large vacuolated macrophage and a few smaller hematopoietic cells are also present, while maturing normoblasts are not conspicuous in this field. The findings are characteristic of parvovirus B19 infection (giant pronormoblasts/lantern cells); confirmation by parvovirus B19 PCR, IgM serology or immunohistochemistry is recommended, particularly in immunocompromised or hemolytic patients.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets of blasts without glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and show TP53 abnormalities, whereas parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with erythroid hypoplasia.
Megaloblastic pronormoblasts have sieve-like open chromatin without a glassy inclusion and are accompanied by abundant maturing megaloblasts and giant metamyelocytes.
Normal pronormoblasts are smaller (about 14-20 µm) with visible nucleoli and no intranuclear inclusions.
These lack the glassy intranuclear inclusion with chromatin margination and are CD61- or CD138-positive, respectively.
